checkpoint_selection: Minimum validation cross-entropy, including initialization; test is evaluated only after all training.
normalization: Per-channel mean and standard deviation from selected training RGB pixels only; alpha is fixed zero after normalization.
initialization: Hidden kernel RandomNormal with variance 2/(3*H*W), zero bias; readout GlorotUniform. Same variance for real and quaternion models.
scope: Exploratory dense RGB pilot, not a full CIFAR-10 benchmark or a compression experiment.
